required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh output of x's shape and dtype inside run() (a flat buffer viewed back to x.shape is acceptable).
One kernel pass over all M*N elements: load x and y, upcast both to fp32, compute x * sigmoid(x) * y (any equivalent sigmoid formulation), downcast once, masked store.

forbidden_substitutions.message: The gate (or its activation) is computed by a PyTorch routine instead of the kernel.
Host-side PyTorch elementwise arithmetic computing the gate outside the kernel.
A library SwiGLU / gated-MLP routine may replace the kernel.
The exponential appears to be evaluated in half precision; it must be fp32.
The multiplier y appears to be gated instead of x.
Writing into or returning an input violates the fresh-output / no-mutation rules.

required_evidence.message: No kernel-level store found; the gate must be done by a kernel.
No exponential / sigmoid primitive found in the kernel.
No fp32 upcast evidence; the gate must be evaluated in fp32.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned tensor must be freshly allocated inside run() with x's shape and dtype and must not share storage with x or y

timing_boundary.notes: Everything inside run() is timed: the flattening views, the output allocation and the single fused elementwise kernel. No cached state, no copy or cast of the inputs, no separate activation pass or global intermediate.
